_readme: Curated web-serial and fanfiction provenance. This replaces the title-matching
scraper: entries are added by hand with a citation, so the app only discloses
what it can support. Origin is context, not a verdict — several of these books
were substantially rewritten and edited before print.

after|anna todd.note: Serialised on Wattpad as One Direction fan fiction before being revised for print.
after|anna todd.source: Widely reported at acquisition; acknowledged by the author and publisher.

the kissing booth|beth reekles.note: Written and posted on Wattpad while the author was fifteen, then acquired.

fifty shades of grey|e. l. james.note: Began as Twilight fan fiction titled Master of the Universe, later rewritten with names and details changed.
fifty shades of grey|e. l. james.source: Extensively documented; acknowledged by the author.

the love hypothesis|ali hazelwood.note: Developed from Star Wars fan fiction, substantially rewritten for publication.

beautiful bastard|christina lauren.note: Originated as Twilight fan fiction before revision and acquisition.

chasing red|isabelle ronin.note: Serialised on Wattpad to a large readership before print publication.
